name: forecast
description: Multi-hour HARMONIE forecast for a place name in Finland (60 h ahead).

name: latest_observations
description: Returns the single most-recent observed value per weather parameter (temperature, humidity, wind speed, etc.) for a named place in Finland from the FMI WFS real-time observation feed.

name: recent_observations
description: Returns time-series weather observations for a named place in Finland over the last 1–48 hours (default 6 h), with one row per parameter per timestamp including lat/lon, parameter name, and value.

name: warnings
description: Active FMI weather warnings for Finland (thunderstorm, wind, rain, snow, cold, forest fire, sea) — English headline, severity, colour, valid-from/to and the affected regions for each.

severity.description: Filter by CAP severity: Minor | Moderate | Severe | Extreme.

include_expired.description: Include warnings whose validity window has already passed (default false).
